seo_title: Every Human Support Services | NDIS & Aged Care in Logan, Wollongong & Ulladulla
seo_description: Family owned, registered NDIS provider offering in-home and community support for NDIS participants, older Australians and private clients in Logan, Wollongong and Ulladulla.
intro: In-home and community support for NDIS participants, older Australians and private clients. We get to know you, match you with people you'll click with, and help you make the most of your funding.

paths.title: I'm looking for support
paths.text: For yourself or someone you care about. We'll talk it through with you, no pressure.

paths.title: I'm referring someone
paths.text: Support coordinators, plan managers and LACs: send a referral in a couple of minutes.

paths.title: I'd like to work with you
paths.text: We're always keen to meet kind, reliable support workers in our areas.

services_intro: Everyday support at home and out in the community, built around your goals, your routine and the things you love doing.
stories_intro: Real people, real stories. Tap to watch.

steps.title: Get in touch
steps.text: Call, send an enquiry, or ask your support coordinator to refer you.

steps.title: Meet and greet
steps.text: We come to you, have a cuppa and learn about your goals, routine and what matters to you.

steps.title: We match your team
steps.text: We pick support workers who suit your needs, personality and interests.

steps.title: Support begins
steps.text: We check in regularly and adjust things as your needs and goals change.

funding.title: NDIS
funding.text: We're a registered NDIS provider, so we can support you whether your plan is agency managed, plan managed or self managed.

funding.title: Aged care
funding.text: We provide aged care support through brokerage. If you already have an aged care provider, they can engage us to deliver your support at home.

funding.title: Private
funding.text: No funding? No problem. You can pay for support privately, with no long contracts.

values.title: Family owned and operated
values.text: You'll deal with real people who know your name, not a call centre.

values.title: Matched to you
values.text: Our diverse team means we can find support workers who fit your lifestyle and personality.

values.title: Getting the most from your funding
values.text: We work with you and your support network to stretch your funding further.

values.title: Ethical and sustainable
values.text: We care about doing things the right way, including reducing waste and recycling.

locations_intro: Local teams in Queensland and on the New South Wales South Coast.

team_heading: Friendly faces you'll get to know
team_intro: Our clients tell us knowing who's coming matters. Meet some of the people behind Every Human.
cta_text: Tell us a little about what you need and we'll take it from there. No pressure, no jargon.
